purpose: S5-T1: demoted signals stay reachable. Resolved, verified-without-impact, and stale-without-current-impact each still reach a real drawer via recentlyResolvedOf and the resolved renderer, so the center's footer History link is honest. A footer that opens an empty pool fails this contract. Snap shapes match the promotion truth table's demotion rows.

cases.name: resolved item is in recentlyResolvedOf and opens the resolved drawer
cases.claim: The live center demotes resolved work; History must still find it by id.

cases.name: verified-without-impact stays in the resolved pool
cases.claim: Verifying with no live affected agent is history, not disappearance. The footer link must resolve the id.

cases.name: stale-without-current-impact stays in the resolved pool
cases.claim: Affected ids that resolve to zero live agents leave the center but keep a History route. Ghost rows must not become unreachable rows.
